title: Security
summary: Security auditing. Audit the box and look at it as an attacker would. The toolkit has Lynis, nmap and debsecan.
consent: Some of these tools probe networks. Some of them read packets. fail2ban installs stopped. Enable it on the Security page.
notes: The box refreshes this toolkit daily when the box is online. The vulnerability data comes from outside the box.
Greenbone/OpenVAS is not on the box. It needs gigabytes of RAM and has no armhf build. Run it from a PC on the hotspot against the box.

The librarian keeps the data of debsecan (the security tracker of Debian, about 2 MB). It downloads the data daily when the box is online. Without internet, debsecan uses the last copy. The page shows the age of the last download. Old data can miss new vulnerabilities.

git.name: debian-cis
git.why: The CIS benchmark checks for Debian. The deep audit of the Security doctor runs them with --audit only. It never runs the fixes.
